title: 中国Q2 GDP同比增长4.3%，低于预期目标下限，为2022年Q4以来最弱
summary: 国家统计局7月15日公布，2026年Q2 GDP同比增长4.3%，低于4.5%市场共识，远低于Q1的5.0%，首次跌破政府4.5%-5.0%目标区间下限。H1累计增速4.7%，出口Q2大增27%，但内需持续疲软，K型分化加剧。
why: GDP首次跌破目标下限，逆周期政策发力预期升温，有利消费/互联网板块估值修复；短期不确定性加大，卖put需关注波动率提升。

title: 习近平出席2026世界人工智能大会并发表主旨讲话，宣布成立全球AI合作组织
summary: 7月17日，习近平在上海出席WAIC 2026开幕式，宣布成立世界人工智能合作组织，承诺5年内向发展中国家提供5000个AI培训名额；国家发改委同步发布AI合作发展行动计划。大会7月17-20日举行，逾1000家企业参展。
why: 国家最高层为AI产业背书，直接利好腾讯（元宝/混元）、阿里（通义）等AI布局的港股/A股核心持仓，也强化AI赛道中长期配置逻辑。

title: 人民银行：加大逆周期和跨周期调节力度，着力扩大内需
summary: 7月15日，央行发表声明，将继续实施适度宽松货币政策，加大逆周期和跨周期调节力度，巩固拓展经济稳中向好势头，重点着力扩大内需、优化供给。此举直接回应Q2 GDP低于目标区间下限的数据压力。
why: 央行明确加码宽松信号，利于消费与科技港股估值抬升；宽松预期下sell put策略（美团、腾讯、阿里等标的）的权利金保护进一步丰厚。

title: 长鑫科技7月16日开启科创板申购，拟募资295亿元，为2026年A股最大IPO
summary: 国产DRAM龙头长鑫科技（证券代码688825）于7月16日正式开启新股申购，拟募资295亿元，为科创板历史第二大IPO（仅次于中芯国际），也是2026年A股最大IPO。公司为中国第一、全球第四的DRAM厂商，估值超4万亿元。7月20日缴款截止，预计近期上市。
why: 国产存储芯片破局里程碑，短期带动半导体打新行情；长鑫上市将重塑DRAM供给格局，影响美光（MU）、SK海力士的竞争格局，值得密切跟踪。

title: Fed July 28-29 FOMC: ~75% odds hold at 3.50-3.75%; 25% hike risk; new Chair Warsh ditches forward guidance
summary: The FOMC convenes July 28-29. CME FedWatch assigns ~75% probability to a hold at 3.50-3.75% and ~25% odds of a 25bp hike. New Chair Kevin Warsh (took helm May 2026) has eliminated forward guidance in favour of pure data-dependence. May CPI 4.2% YoY; core PCE 3.4% — both well above the 2% target.
why: 25%加息概率高于市场预期，对美股及港股均有压制；sell put策略在高利率+高IV环境下权利金丰厚，但需保留足够行权价缓冲应对潜在加息冲击。

title: Gold slips below $4,000 despite US-Iran strikes; Strait of Hormuz closure drives oil higher, raises rate-hike fears
summary: XAU/USD fell below $4,000 on July 17 after briefly reaching $4,015 on July 14. US strikes on Iran and Iran's threatened Strait of Hormuz closure pushed oil sharply higher — paradoxically bearish for gold as higher oil raises inflation expectations and potential Fed tightening, overriding the traditional safe-haven bid.
why: 金价下行对老铺黄金（6181.HK）情绪偏负；美伊冲突加大全球市场波动率，科技/半导体持仓的期权IV也因此走高，短期卖put需留意保护。

title: Circle faces July 18 GENIUS Act compliance deadline; Fed rolls out new stablecoin oversight rules
summary: The GENIUS Act's one-year implementation deadline (original signing: July 18, 2025) expired July 18, 2026, triggering full compliance requirements for all stablecoin issuers. Federal Reserve simultaneously released new stablecoin oversight rules. CRCL stock testing key support as market assesses regulatory impact.
why: Circle（CRCL）是直接持仓，GENIUS Act正式落地是重大监管里程碑；结合OCC银行牌照，合规轨道确立，中长期利好，短期需观察新规细节和CRCL股价支撑位。

title: Apple surpasses Nvidia as most valuable US company; Nvidia -3.5%+ as AI chip selloff spreads to Asia
summary: Apple overtook Nvidia to become the most valuable US company by market cap as Apple gained ~0.3% while Nvidia dropped more than 3.5% on July 17-18. Asian semiconductor stocks extended the selloff — HSI down 0.8%, CSI 300 -1.64% — on growing concerns about AI capex sustainability. Nvidia has fallen ~10.8% in June; next earnings are late August.
why: 英伟达（NVDA）持仓在AI算力担忧下回调，短期波动率高；Apple取代Nvidia市值王座是里程碑，反映市场对AI算力泡沫的再评价；sell put需适当下移行权价保护。

title: Futu Holdings: CSRC proposes ~RMB1.85B penalty for unlicensed mainland China brokerage; US class actions filed
summary: On May 22, 2026, China's CSRC issued Futu Holdings a penalty pre-notification: confiscation of ~RMB470M illegal gains + RMB1.38B fine (total ~RMB1.85B) for conducting regulated brokerage activities without required mainland China licenses. Multiple US securities class action lawsuits were subsequently filed against Futu and its executives covering the period May 2023-May 2026.
why: 富途（FUTU）是持仓标的；合计处罚约超一年净利润，叠加集体诉讼，短期估值受压；建议降低行权价保护，并重新评估是否维持仓位。

title: Alibaba and Ant unit pay combined $600M in DOJ non-prosecution deal (July 2); BABA +11% on July 8
summary: July 2, 2026: Alibaba ($325M) and Ant's AUS Merchant Services ($275M) agreed to pay a combined $600M in non-prosecution agreements to resolve ~80,000 prohibited transactions of US-bound pharmaceuticals and illegal goods (2016-2024). The settlement removes a long-running legal overhang. BABA surged ~11% on July 8. Company is also partnering with Apple to deploy AI on China-market iPhones.
why: 重大法律尾部风险出清，积极催化剂；叠加苹果AI合作，阿里巴巴（BABA/9988.HK）基本面叙事改善，中长期持仓逻辑强化。

title: Micron Q3 FY2026: Revenue $41.5B (+346% YoY), crushed estimates; Q4 guidance $50B; HBM4 at 2x ramp pace
summary: Micron (MU) fiscal Q3 2026 (ended May 28): revenue $41.5B vs $35.8B estimate (+74% QoQ, +346% YoY); net income $28.2B (+205% YoY). Q4 guidance: ~$50B revenue, ~$31 EPS (vs $25.31 consensus). Cloud memory revenue +300%+ to $13.77B. HBM4 shipments to Nvidia Vera Rubin began March 2026, ramping at twice the pace of HBM3E with yields ahead of schedule.
why: 美光（MU）是持仓标的；业绩和指引远超预期，HBM4提前放量验证AI存储超级周期延续；sell put权利金丰厚，可继续维持或适度滚动。

title: SK Hynix -15.4% worst single-day record (July 13); Q2 profit seen 8% below consensus due to fixed HBM pricing
summary: SK Hynix collapsed 15.4% in Seoul on July 13 — worst session on record — after Korea Investment & Securities projected Q2 operating profit at 60.4 trillion won vs. 65 trillion won consensus (-8%). Fixed-price HBM contracts prevented capturing gains from conventional DRAM (+30% QoQ spot) and NAND (+50% QoQ) price surges. HBM4 full mass production pushed to Q3 2026.
why: SK海力士是港股南方两倍做多ETF（7709.HK）底层标的；固价合同压制Q2弹性，HBM4量产延至Q3，短期持仓波动扩大；可考虑观望等待Q2正式财报。

title: Pop Mart +6.9% to HK$168.1 on World Cup LABUBU launch; HK$4.51B turnover; Duan Yongping raised stake to 7.65%
summary: Pop Mart (9992.HK) surged 6.87% to HK$168.1 on the day of its MEGA LABUBU 400%/1000% FIFA World Cup 26 special edition launch; turnover hit HK$4.51B. All 1000% pre-order quotas sold out ahead of the 10pm on-sale; delivery started July 18. Separately, notable investor Duan Yongping raised his stake from 6.85% to 7.65% (~102M shares) via ~HK$1.59B purchases at up to HK$150/share.
why: FIFA世界杯LABUBU是里程碑级IP出圈事件，验证全球变现能力；段永平大规模加仓是强力基本面背书，中长期持仓逻辑更坚实；IV升高可利用covered call锁定部分涨幅。

title: Alphabet reports Q2 2026 on July 22; Google Cloud 63% growth expected; Gemini 3.5 Pro delay hit stock -4%
summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) reports Q2 2026 after US close on July 22 (earnings call 4:30am HKT July 23). Q1 2026: revenue $109.9B (+22% YoY), Google Cloud $20B (+63%), record backlog $462B, operating margin 36.1%. Gemini 3.5 Pro launch postponed after poor internal benchmarks, causing stock to slide ~4%. Street expects continued Cloud acceleration.
why: 谷歌（GOOGL）是持仓标的；财报前IV高企，是滚动covered call的时间窗口；Gemini延期显示AI竞争加剧，Cloud超高增速是核心看点，Q2数据将决定下一阶段走势。

title: Palantir +14% on Nvidia sovereign AI deal and $10B US Army NGC2 contract win; DA Davidson Buy $175
summary: Palantir (PLTR) rallied ~14% in early July: (1) New Palantir-Nvidia partnership pairs Foundry/AIP with Nemotron AI in air-gapped sovereign government environments; (2) US Army selected Palantir Foundry for the NGC2 enterprise cloud-data programme ($10B/10-year consolidated deal). DA Davidson upgraded to Buy, target $175. Q1 2026: revenue $1.633B (+85% YoY); US Government revenue +84% to $687M.
why: Palantir（PLTR）是持仓标的；国防AI+NVIDIA双重背书强化政府AI护城河；Q2财报前sell put权利金吸引力高，较高点跌37%提供重新布局机会。

title: Tesla Robotaxi launches fully driverless in Miami (July 5); stock +6.7% to $419.77; Europe registrations +57%
summary: Tesla launched driverless Robotaxi in Miami on July 5 — second city after Austin — using fully autonomous Model Y with no safety driver. Now active across Austin, Dallas, Houston, SF Bay Area, and Miami. TSLA closed +6.7% to $419.77 on July 6. European EV registrations +57% in first 5 months of 2026. Shareholders pressing Musk on missed FSD/Optimus targets via Q2 earnings portal.
why: 特斯拉（TSLA）是持仓标的；Robotaxi城市扩张路线图推进是正向催化，欧洲需求回暖；但股东问询FSD/Optimus进度显示期望管理压力，Q2财报前需关注波动率。

title: Costco June net sales $29.24B (+10.6% YoY); comp sales +8.8%; quarterly dividend declared
summary: Costco (COST) reported 5-week June net sales of $29.24B, up 10.6% YoY (ended July 5, 2026). 44-week cumulative net sales: $250.43B (+10.1%). Comparable sales grew 8.8% for the period; digital comps +20.9%. Company also declared a quarterly cash dividend.
why: Costco稳定的高个位数同店销售增速证实高端消费韧性；会员费收入模式提供下行保护，是sell put行权价下方良好缓冲，持仓逻辑持续强化。

title: Circle wins OCC national bank charter (July 10); 'Circle National Trust' to manage USDC reserves under federal oversight
summary: Circle received final OCC approval to open First National Digital Currency Bank, N.A. (Circle National Trust), enabling federal-bank-level management and disclosure of USDC reserves. This is Circle's most significant institutional credential since its CRCL listing, directly aligned with the July 18 GENIUS Act implementation deadline.
why: Circle（CRCL）获国家级银行牌照，大幅提升USDC机构公信力；与GENIUS Act落地形成双重利好，中长期为USDC扩张铺路，CRCL估值重估空间值得关注。

title: SanDisk (SNDK) +857% in H1 2026 on NAND surge; -15% in July chip selloff; Goldman raises target to $2,200
summary: SanDisk (SNDK) stock skyrocketed 857% in H1 2026 driven by a structural NAND flash shortage fuelled by AI infrastructure demand. Shares fell ~15% on July 15 in the broader chip selloff. Goldman Sachs raised price target to $2,200 (Buy) on July 5 citing supply tightness. Fiscal Q4 2026 earnings due August 5.
why: SanDisk（SNDK）是闪存/存储持仓，H1大涨后7月回调属正常整理；NAND供给持续紧张，Goldman看好，F4财报前是sell put窗口；回调幅度需关注，防止行权。

title: Trip.com Q1 2026: Revenue +17% to RMB16.2B; international OTA +65%; inbound travel bookings +90% YoY
summary: Trip.com Group (TCOM/9961.HK) Q1 2026: total net revenues RMB16.2B (US$2.4B), +17% YoY. International OTA platform gross bookings +65% YoY; inbound travel bookings surged ~90% YoY. International business is now 40% of total revenue. Q2 2026 guidance: EPS $1.15, revenue ~$2.50B. Goal: serve 200M inbound travelers over 5 years.
why: 携程（TCOM/9961.HK）是持仓标的；入境游+65%-90%爆发性增长远超预期，出海战略实质推进中，有力支撑估值提升；旅游消费板块与消费赛道逻辑共振。
